title: Dogen's Heart of the Way
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: The main teaching of this Soto Zen dharma talk emphasizes the importance of cultivating a genuine, non-dualistic mind that embodies the true nature of reality, as explored through Dogen's teachings. This involves embracing interconnectedness and impermanence, and finding practical ways to cultivate wholesome qualities such as mindfulness, devotion, and humility. By doing so, one can deepen their understanding of the Buddha way and realize a more authentic expression of themselves.
